title: Paid Media Manager – Google Ads & Meta Ads
description:
Datameris is looking for a Paid Media Manager with deep expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads to lead the execution and optimisation of paid acquisition across our businesses and client portfolio. This is a high\-impact role with direct responsibility for acquisition efficiency, lead quality, customer growth, and the commercial performance of paid media. We are looking for a specialist with substantial hands\-on experience—someone who understands the platforms beyond campaign setup and standard optimisation, and who has developed strong judgment through managing budgets, testing aggressively, scaling successful campaigns, and diagnosing underperformance. The person we hire should combine platform expertise, analytical depth, commercial judgment, and ownership.

Key Responsibilities

● Own the strategy, execution, optimisation, and scaling of campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads

● Manage advertising budgets with clear accountability for efficiency and business outcomes

● Build campaign structures based on market, intent, audience, funnel stage, and commercial objectives

● Drive improvements across CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, and revenue efficiency

● Develop and execute structured testing across audiences, creatives, messaging, keywords, offers, bidding strategies, and landing pages

● Identify the underlying causes of performance changes and determine the appropriate corrective action

Scale successful campaigns while maintaining acquisition quality and efficiency

● Build effective prospecting, remarketing, and retargeting frameworks

● Work closely with creative teams to translate performance insights into stronger concepts and messaging

● Collaborate with web, product, and sales teams to improve the complete acquisition journey

● Evaluate campaign performance against downstream lead quality, conversion, and revenue

● Maintain high standards of tracking, attribution, measurement, and reporting

● Translate media performance into clear recommendations and business decisions

Platform Expertise

Google Ads Strong hands\-on experience across:

● Search

● Performance Max

● Demand Gen

● YouTube

● Display and remarketing

● Keyword and search\-intent strategy

● Search term analysis

● Match types and negative keyword strategy

● Smart bidding

● Target CPA and Target ROAS

● Conversion value optimisation

● Audience signals

● Auction insights

● Budget allocation and scaling

Meta Ads Strong hands\-on experience across: ● Campaign architecture ● Advantage\+ campaigns ● Broad and interest\-based targeting ● Lookalike audiences ● Prospecting and retargeting ● Creative testing ● Audience testing ● Campaign consolidation

Budget optimisation ● Scaling ● Creative fatigue analysis ● Placement strategy ● Meta Pixel ● Conversion API ● Attribution and measurement Measurement \& Analytics Strong working knowledge of: ● GA4 ● Google Tag Manager ● Meta Pixel ● Conversion API ● Conversion tracking

UTM architecture ● Attribution ● Funnel analytics ● Landing\-page conversion ● CRM and lead\-quality analysis ● CAC ● CPL ● ROAS ● Revenue attribution

We expect a strong understanding of the difference between platform\-reported performance and actual commercial performance. The objective is not to optimise dashboards. It is to acquire the right customers at sustainable economics

title: Digital Growth Manager
description:
Datameris Launchpad is looking for a **Digital Growth Manager** to lead and scale our digital acquisition and growth initiatives. This role will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies across paid marketing, organic channels, social media, content, email, and conversion funnels.

The ideal candidate will combine **strategic thinking, performance marketing expertise, analytics, creative problem\-solving, and strong execution** to drive qualified leads, improve conversions, and contribute directly to business growth.

You will work closely with the **Sales, Product, and Marketing teams** to optimize customer journeys, improve lead quality, strengthen funnel performance, and maximize marketing ROI. The role also involves building scalable marketing systems, monitoring key performance metrics, conducting experiments, and leading a high\-performing digital marketing team.

This is a **high\-ownership role** suited for a growth\-focused marketing professional who is comfortable moving between strategy and hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced EdTech environment.

What You’ll Own

● Own and execute the digital growth strategy for Launchpad in alignment with business, product, and revenue priorities

● Lead acquisition across paid, organic, social, content, email, and funnel\-led channels ● Build scalable systems for lead generation, nurturing, conversion, attribution, and performance measurement

● Own core marketing metrics including CAC, CPL, qualified lead cost, funnel conversion, channel efficiency, and ROI

● Partner closely with Sales to improve lead quality, counselling conversion, and enrolment outcomes

● Continuously test audiences, offers, creatives, messaging, landing pages, funnels, and channels

● Build clear dashboards and decision systems that turn marketing data into action

● Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing digital marketing team

● Translate customer insights, sales feedback, competitor activity, and market signals into growth initiatives

● Identify underperforming channels or campaigns early and make clear decisions on what to scale, improve, or stop

What We’re Looking For

● Strong experience in digital marketing, growth, demand generation, or customer acquisition

● Proven ability to connect marketing activity to measurable business outcomes

● Strong understanding of performance marketing, funnels, conversion, positioning, and customer journeys

● Strong analytical ability and comfort working with numbers, experiments, and performance data

● Ability to lead specialists across different marketing disciplines

● High ownership, bias for action, and strong execution discipline

● Ability to prioritise effectively in a fast\-moving environment

● Strong communication, judgment, and decision\-making skills

● Ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution

● A mindset focused on continuously learning, testing, and improving Experience in EdTech, education, SaaS, career services, consumer internet, or another high\-growth business is preferred.

title: Purchase Manager – Solar Products
description:
Purchase Manager – Solar Products

**Location:** Angamaly, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** Solar Energy / Renewable Energy  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Experience:** 3\+ years  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Purchase Manager** with relevant experience in **solar products and equipment procurement**. The candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end purchasing, vendor management, price negotiation, purchase order management, and ensuring the timely availability of quality materials for solar projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement of **solar products, equipment, components, and project materials**.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors.
* Source materials and obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms.
* Prepare and manage purchase orders and procurement documentation.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials according to project requirements.
* Coordinate with **Project, Stores, Accounts, and Management teams** for smooth procurement operations.
* Verify product specifications, quality, quantity, pricing, and delivery terms before placing orders.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers and develop new vendor networks.
* Monitor pending purchase orders, delivery schedules, and material availability.
* Track market prices and maintain awareness of solar product availability and pricing trends.
* Resolve supplier\-related issues involving quality, delivery, pricing, and replacement of materials.
* Maintain accurate records of quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor details.
* Ensure cost\-effective procurement while maintaining required quality standards.

Required Qualifications

* Degree/Diploma or relevant qualification in **Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering**, or a related field.
* Minimum **3 years of relevant experience in purchase/procurement**, preferably in the **Solar Energy or Renewable Energy industry**.
* Strong knowledge of **solar products, equipment, components, and procurement processes**.
* Excellent vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Office, especially MS Excel**.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills.

Preferred Candidate

* Candidates with hands\-on experience in **solar product purchasing/procurement** will be preferred.
* **Immediate joiners** or candidates with a short notice period are preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple procurement requirements.
* Strong focus on **cost control, timely delivery, and vendor relationship management**.

Compensation

description:

* Handle walk\-in customers, understand their requirements, and provide accurate product/service information.
* Enter walk\-in and lead details into company software and update the status daily.
* Address customer queries professionally and ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Ensure the safe movement and submission of gold and cash to Head Office/regional office or other branches as required.
* Maintain proper grooming standards, wear company uniform or formals with formal shoes.

**2\. Sales \& Lead Management**

* Create and maintain a database of prospective customers, follow\-up until conversion, and support customers throughout the closing process.
* Execute marketing initiatives and distribute leaflets/pamphlets near by radius to increase brand visibility.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to increase repeat business and referrals.

* Visit nearby NBFCs regularly to generate business leads.
* Build and maintain a healthy NBFC network and ensure consistent business inflow.

**4\. Sales Process Oversight \& Inventory Management**

* Oversee complete sales cycle from greeting to negotiation and final closing.
* Track daily sales performance and ensure targets are met.
* Maintain stock records, monitor stock ageing, and coordinate for replenishment.
* Ensure all operational equipment (POS, weighing machines, etc.) are functional.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports on sales, stock, and transactions.

**5\. Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* Follow all safety, compliance, stock handling procedures and company SOPs without deviation.
* Conduct regular stock audits and ensure branch security protocols are followed.

**6\. Meetings, Reporting \& Inter\-Branch Support**

* Attend weekly, monthly, and quarterly review meetings without fail.
* Be flexible to support and work from other branches when required based on business needs.
* Ensure timely reporting, assigned tasks completion, and coordination with Regional Office /Head Office.
